name: Loisiland (PlaYce Warda)
description: A modern indoor amusement center located inside the PlaYce Warda Mall, offering arcade games, virtual reality simulators, bumper cars, and dedicated soft play zones for toddlers.
bonASavoir: Open daily aligned with mall hours (usually 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM). Entrance to the zone is free, but games operate via a rechargeable card system where activities cost between 1,000 XAF and 3,500 XAF per play. It gets very busy on rainy days and during public holidays.
